note: Term corrections found by auditing the second pass: a singular term that missed a plural ('District Mineral Foundations'), and a bare '13' that matched '13 member states' rather than the 13 projects outside the EU.

claims.text: District Mineral Foundations, funded by levies on mining leaseholders, had collected more than ₹1 lakh crore cumulatively by early 2025. Odisha, Chhattisgarh and Jharkhand together accounted for more than half of the total.
Under the Act, the European Commission designated 47 strategic projects in EU member states in March 2025 and 13 outside the EU in June 2025.
